package.name: vrx_docking_sim
package.description: Complete docking simulator: USV and dock as ROS 2 nodes ported from docking/guerleboat and docking/guerledocking, dock pose broadcast over UDP, ArduPilot Rover SITL driving the USV motors directly, Mission Planner supervision, RC-style joystick, APF field/setpoint visualization. Strictly additive: does not modify vrx_apf_dock, vrx_apf_dock_teleop or vrx_ardupilot, which keep working unchanged. See PROPOSITION_SIMULATEUR_COMPLET.md and CORRESPONDANCE_DOCKING.md at the workspace root.
